Ray Vega enjoys a productive career in jazz as a dynamic soloist, valued sideman, and prolific composer. He is a member of the music faculty at the University of Vermont and was recognized in 2015 with a University Scholar Award.
Ray was interviewed via Zoom on July 20, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Ray Vega with me this morning. You are now a — let me find your quote — a Vermonterican?
